name: Borrowix v1.4.0
body:
## What's changed in v1.4.0

- feat(portal): finalize staff and student history and request views (7b0cde4)

- feat(style): add new platform themes and aesthetic improvements (174b2e9)
- ui: enhance shared components, layouts, and authentication pages (4fcb3db)
- chore(core): update base infrastructure, hooks, and type definitions (a967d80)
- fix: resolve motion import error and bypass SSL for GitHub updates on Windows (633821c)
- ui: move settings to sidebar for staff and student and remove from dropdown (07639d6)
- feat(student): implement settings pages including profile and updates tabs (a7f03bc)
- feat(staff): implement settings pages including profile and updates tabs (f288a92)
- feat(settings): add core settings logic and routes for staff and student roles (01eb3b4)
